discovery: Development of massively parallel next-generation DNA sequencing by sequencing-by-synthesis (Solexa/Illumina chemistry)
rationale: Sequencing-by-synthesis rests on chemical innovation: reversible-terminator fluorescent nucleotides and clonal cluster amplification on surfaces. It transformed genomics, medicine and biology, and its inventors have already won the Breakthrough Prize and the Millennium Technology Prize. The Chemistry committee has recently favored chemistry that serves biology (2018, 2020, 2022, 2024). Since materials chemistry won in 2025 (MOFs), a bio-enabling chemical technology is a plausible pick for 2026.
